items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Yeah, I know him. He, he played, uh, first time I met him, he was playing violin.

ctx.x: That's right over there. I was a block from here. Yeah, block from here. Biggye Lillie and, and, and, uh, Bechet. Uh-huh. You know, I knew Professor Monetta, when he was teaching me. Yeah, yeah, yeah. He told me about all these different places. Yeah, uh-huh. And then I've been working-

Did you know him, too? Professor Melody, yeah. Manuel Monetta. Yes. Yeah, I know him. He, he played, uh, first time I met him, he was playing violin. Yeah. But he's a piano, he plays piano, and he plays trombone, and he plays cornet, too. Where did you hear him play? You heard him play in the district? No, I played in different places. Yeah. He played, uh, two trumpets together. Yeah, I've seen him. Uh, uh, how that's done, I don't know.
